title: AI demand forecasting cuts errors by 20% to 50%
takeaways: AI forecasting can cut forecast errors by 20% to 50%.
Product unavailability can fall by up to 65%.
70% of large firms will use AI forecasting by 2030.
High performers use AI in forecasting 40% vs 19%.
50% of large Indian retailers use AI for demand planning.
source_note: Sources: McKinsey via Oracle; Gartner 2025; Honeywell 2025
